metadata.purpose: Validate that repos/platform/scripts/validate-local-deployment.sh returns correct exit codes based on deployment health
testStrategy: Run validation script and capture exit code
Verify exit code matches deployment health
Verify output messages match exit code

exitCodeLogic.healthy: Exit code 0 when PODS_NOT_READY == 0 AND SERVICES_WITHOUT_ENDPOINTS == 0
exitCodeLogic.unhealthy: Exit code 1 when PODS_NOT_READY > 0 OR SERVICES_WITHOUT_ENDPOINTS > 0
